WITH g AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(articount) AS avg_art
  FROM scanfeatures
  GROUP BY equipref
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_art) AS overall_avg FROM g
),
k AS (
  SELECT g.equipref, g.avg_art, g.avg_art - o.overall_avg AS diff_overall
  FROM g
  JOIN o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  WHERE g.avg_art > o.overall_avg
),
f AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_art) AS final_avg FROM k
)
SELECT k.equipref,
       k.avg_art,
       k.diff_overall,
       k.avg_art / f.final_avg AS ratio
FROM k
JOIN f ON f.final_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (k.avg_art / f.final_avg IS NULL), (k.avg_art / f.final_avg) DESC
LIMIT 10
